question: What is the English name of the category 'cama_mesa_banho', and how many products does it have?
sql:
WITH cat AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.product_category_name_english AS english_name,
        COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count
    FROM category_translation ct
    JOIN products p
      ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
    WHERE ct.product_category_name = 'cama_mesa_banho'
    GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english
)
SELECT english_name, product_count FROM cat
